rules.node: a folder; files directly in frontend/src, ui/src and frappe/shell are one node each
rules.counted: non-test .ts/.vue/.js/.mjs/.py files; tests/, stories/, *.test.*, *.spec.*, *.stories.*, *.d.ts left out
rules.uiScope: ui/src files reached from frontend/src or frontend/plugin through imports

edgeKinds.import: a static or dynamic import, or a Python import
edgeKinds.virtual: an import of a module the vite plugin generates
edgeKinds.api: a client string naming a whitelisted Python method
edgeKinds.hook: a frappe.shell path named in hooks.py

rules.count: import statements (or method strings) from one folder into the other; typeOnly and dynamic count the `import type` and `import()` ones among them
